top_signal.title: Anyone sourced UAE suppliers remotely?
top_signal.summary: I run an online modest-wear brand and I’m looking to add abayas for the holiday season. I’m mainly looking for UAE-based suppliers who can provide wholesale ready-made designs and can also do some customization.    I can’t travel there right now, so it would need to be fully remote. I’ve reached out to a bunch of suppliers but have gotten few responses. Some of the other pages I have found look pretty sketchy as well. If you have any recommendations or could help with this I’d really appreciate it. Thanks!       submitted by     /u/Lower-Tonight-6662       [link]       [comments]
